scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server/api && npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix adminClient
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint --prefix server/api -- --fix && npm run lint --prefix client -- --fix && npm run lint --prefix adminClient -- --fix
scripts.dev:old: concurrently -n api,client,admin -c green,blue,yellow "cd server && docker compose up -d && docker compose watch api" "npm start --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix adminClient"
scripts.dev:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec api npm run migrate
scripts.dev:seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec api npm run seed
scripts.dev:seed:demo: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec api npm run seed -- --demo
